$comment: Offline RVA registry for TextShaping.dll internal functions. Address resolution NEVER downloads PDBs or queries the network; it reads this file and verifies byte signatures before hooking (never blind-hook). Keys are the TextShaping FileVersion major family (first three dotted segments, e.g. 10.0.26100). To add a new build, follow tools/ghidra/README.md (decompile -> learn ApplyFeatures/ApplyLookup RVAs -> dump signatures with tools/pe_rva.py -> append an entry here).
